title: Non-asymptotic oracle inequalities for the Lasso in high-dimensional mixture of experts
abstract: We study Lasso estimation for high-dimensional softmax-gated Gaussian mixture-of-experts (SGMoE) regression models, where the predictor dimension P may exceed the sample size N. Under bounded parameters, we establish a non-asymptotic Kullback–Leibler (KL) oracle inequality with an explicit sufficient regularization level and explicit dependence on N, P, response dimension Q, number of experts K, and boundedness constants. We derive sparse well-specified and approximation-space rates, showing how deterministic SGMoE approximation error transfers into statistical KL-risk bounds. The theory extends to random covariates and, under misspecification, controls the best Gaussian SGMoE approximation in the candidate class. Reproducible experiments validate KL decay and density recovery, compare Lasso with SCAD when $$P>N$$ P > N, evaluate model-selection criteria, handle multivariate covariance structures, and assess high-dimensional biological benchmarks relevant to heterogeneous genotype–phenotype mapping, omics-to-trait prediction, and AI-enabled virtual-cell modelling in systems biology.
affiliations: Institute of Mathematics for Industry, Kyushu University
venue: Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics
published_venue: Annals of the Institute of Statistical Mathematics

llm.novelty_zh: 为高维SGMoE的Lasso估计建立非渐近KL oracle不等式，并给出稀疏收敛速率。
llm.summary_zh: 论文研究高维softmax门控高斯混合专家回归的Lasso估计，给出非渐近KL oracle不等式与稀疏率，并处理了误设情形。实验验证了KL衰减，并比较了Lasso与SCAD及模型选择准则。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为混合专家模型的高维统计理论提供了保证，与虚拟细胞的关联仅限于基准数据的讨论。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要中的生物基准仅作为应用示例，与虚拟细胞建模的直接关系未展开。

title: Categorization and analysis of 16 computational methods for estimating cell potency from single-cell RNA-seq data
abstract: Inferring hidden cellular dynamics from static single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data remains a critical challenge. Beyond pseudotime trajectories and RNA velocities, cell potency provides another perspective by estimating cellular differentiation potential from gene expression levels. We review 16 computational methods that define cell potency under different, sometimes contrasting, assumptions. On the basis of how they summarize gene expression into a potency measure, we categorize them into average-based, entropy-based, and knowledge-based methods. Using a unified set of mathematical notations, we detail their methodologies, explain key similarities and differences within and between categories, and summarize usage complexities. Given the diversity of methods, community benchmark datasets at single-cell resolution and careful sensitivity analyses are crucial for evaluating methods from multiple angles and potentially improving stability and generalizability. This article provides a basis for method benchmarking and highlights the remaining challenge of comparing methods for inferring pseudotime trajectories, RNA velocities, and cell potency.

llm.novelty_zh: 在统一数学记号下，对16种细胞潜能估计方法进行了系统分类与比较。
llm.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了16种从单细胞RNA测序数据估计细胞潜能的计算方法，并按平均值、熵和先验知识三类进行归纳。文章用统一记号说明各方法的假设、差异与使用复杂度，并强调需要单细胞分辨率的社区基准数据集与敏感性分析。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为细胞潜能方法的选择和后续基准评测提供了整理性的参考框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Confounder-robust causal discovery and inference in Perturb-seq using proxy and instrumental variables
abstract: Emerging single-cell technologies that combine CRISPR-based genetic perturbations with single-cell RNA sequencing, such as Perturb-seq, offer unprecedented opportunities to uncover cause-and-effect relationships among genes. Nonetheless, Perturb-seq experiments are subject to unobserved factors that, if not properly handled, can severely bias the inferred causal relationships between genes. These latent factors may arise not only from intrinsic molecular features of the regulatory elements, but also from unmeasured genes omitted due to cost-constrained experimental designs. Although methods for analyzing large-scale Perturb-seq data are rapidly maturing, approaches that explicitly account for such unobserved confounders when inferring causal gene networks are still lacking. Here, we propose a novel approach to accurately reconstruct causal gene networks from Perturb-seq data even when important confounders are missing. Our framework leverages proxy and instrumental variable strategies to exploit the rich information embedded in the perturbations, enabling unbiased estimation of the underlying directed acyclic graph (DAG) of gene expression. Applications to both comprehensive synthetic data and real CRISPR interference experiments in K562 cells demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline approaches that lack principled adjustments for unmeasured confounding, yielding more accurate and biologically relevant recovery of the true causal DAGs.
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
published_venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

llm.novelty_zh: 将代理变量与工具变量策略引入 Perturb-seq 因果基因网络重建，以校正未观测的混杂因子。
llm.summary_zh: 论文针对 Perturb-seq 中未观测混杂因子导致因果基因网络估计偏倚的问题，提出利用扰动信息作为代理变量与工具变量的框架，以估计基因表达的有向无环图。作者在合成数据和 K562 细胞 CRISPR 干扰实验中报告其优于缺乏混杂校正的基线方法。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法为从扰动实验推断因果基因关系并处理未测混杂提供了思路，有助于提高调控网络推断的可靠性。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要仅提及在 K562 真实 CRISPR 干扰实验上验证，其他数据集与假设前提的稳健性未提及。

title: Latent causal diffusions for single-cell perturbation modeling
abstract: Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.

llm.novelty_zh: 把单细胞表达视为测量噪声下的平稳扩散过程，并提出 CLIPR 从扰动响应中线性化恢复直接因果效应。
llm.summary_zh: LCD 将单细胞基因表达建模为受测量噪声影响的平稳扩散过程，用于预测未见扰动组合引起的分布变化。CLIPR 在线性漂移假设下可识别直接因果效应，并在模拟系统与全基因组扰动筛选中恢复功能模块与因果关系。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 将生成模型与因果推断结合，既能改进未见扰动预测，又能解释转录组的调控机制。
llm.limitations_zh: 因果识别依赖线性漂移假设，摘要未讨论该假设在复杂生物系统中的适用范围。

title: RAGCell: retrieval-augmented generation as supervision for versatile single-cell analysis
abstract: MOTIVATION: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are transforming computational biology by enabling generalizable, task-agnostic representations for versatile single-cell analysis. Despite their progress in facilitating rapid deployment for downstream tasks, off-the-shelf scFMs still have some overlooked concerns: (I) (Pretraining Cost.) Pretrain-based scFMs necessitate pretraining on a vast volume of cells, rendering it draining resources in applications. (II) (Heterogeneous Gap.) Large language model (LLM)-based scFMs ignore the tremendous heterogeneous gap between LLM textual and raw cellular spaces, leading to insufficient capability when facing downstream tasks. RESULTS: To this end, we introduce RAGCell, a versatile single-cell analysis framework that achieves a double-win in both cost-effectiveness and high performance. The success of RAGCell lies in two key aspects: Leveraging LLMs to construct cell-level and feature-level knowledge databases, which serve as supervision signals for training the cell model and significantly reduce the training cost (>pretrain-based scFMs). Aligning cell representations with text embeddings from the bi-level knowledge databases, enabling knowledge transfer from textual spaces to cellular spaces and effectively mitigating the heterogeneous gap (>LLM-based scFMs). Through extensive experiments on five downstream single-cell analysis tasks, we demonstrate that RAGCell achieves outstanding performance compared to state-of-the-art scFMs while operating at less than ∼1/10 the cost of pretrain-based scFMs. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code is available at our supplementary file. Embeddings can be found in https://sites.google.com/yale.edu/scelmolib/home.

llm.novelty_zh: 用 LLM 构建的细胞级与特征级知识库作为训练监督，并将细胞表征与文本嵌入对齐，实现知识向细胞空间迁移。
llm.summary_zh: RAGCell 面向单细胞基础模型，利用 LLM 构建两级知识库作为训练监督信号，以降低对大规模预训练的依赖。通过将细胞表征与文本嵌入对齐，它把文本空间的知识迁移到细胞空间。作者报告其在五个下游单细胞分析任务上优于现有单细胞基础模型，且训练成本约为预训练类模型的十分之一。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 以较低训练成本获得具有竞争力的单细胞基础模型下游性能，适合资源受限的应用场景。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体基线与指标的量化结果。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
abstract: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

llm.novelty_zh: 用统一的源条件化传输框架建模时序、遗传和化学群体转移，并以小批量最优传输为条件流匹配提供配对。
llm.summary_zh: TempoBridge以源细胞群体初始化潜空间传输，并将其固定的经验分布摘要与演化中的细胞状态、流时间及转移描述符一同输入速度场。推理时无需目标表达或OT计算。在留出供体、基因组合和化合物上，它相对scGen、scGPT及CellFlow适配器在分布误差和药物效应相关性上有所改进，消融实验显示源上下文、OT配对和流匹配均有贡献。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为群体层面的细胞状态转移提供统一的条件生成建模思路，且推理不依赖目标表达，便于扩展到多种扰动类型。

title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
abstract: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出以简单输入下限与完整输入上限衡量探针得分的 headroom 框架。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作将探针分数放在 floor 与 ceiling 之间解读，并证明 headroom 会在两种情形下消失。在元分析 transformer 上，分布偏移使预测误差上升 12–15 倍，但模型仍恢复相近比例的 headroom。作者还指出 scGPT 只部分编码生物学变异，并复核了四项 LLM 探针研究。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为解读探针分数提供了基线，有助于避免把输入中已有的信息误判为模型表征。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及该框架在更大规模单细胞数据上的验证情况。

title: GeneICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for Bulk Transcriptomics
abstract: Gene expression is widely measured in biomedicine, yet clinical outcome prediction remains challenging due to high dimensionality, strong feature correlations, and limited labeled data. Large self-supervised transcriptomic foundation models often fail to outperform simple supervised baselines. Tabular foundation models offer an alternative through in-context learning, but are typically pretrained on generic synthetic data rather than transcriptomic structure. We ask whether transcriptomics-aware pretraining, rather than scale, is the missing ingredient. Towards this end, we introduce GeneICL, a 4.2M-parameter tabular foundation model combining a semi-synthetic pretraining prior built from measured bulk expression profiles with a parameter-efficient recurrent architecture. We further enable right-censored survival prediction via a training-free reduction to regression using Cox partial-likelihood residuals. We evaluate GeneICL on 80 clinical outcome-prediction tasks spanning classification, regression, and survival. Tabular foundation models consistently outperform self-supervised transcriptomic models, while GeneICL achieves the best overall rank among evaluated foundation models and tuned baselines. GeneICL does so with up to 387$\times$ fewer parameters, no gradient updates at inference, and predictions within seconds on a laptop CPU.
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

llm.novelty_zh: 用实测bulk表达谱构造半合成预训练先验，并结合循环架构与Cox偏似然残差，实现免梯度推理的生存预测。
llm.summary_zh: GeneICL是一个4.2M参数的表格基础模型，预训练先验来自实测的bulk表达谱，并通过Cox偏似然残差支持右删失生存预测。在80项临床结局任务上，它优于自监督转录组模型，并取得了最佳综合排名，参数量最多少387倍。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作表明转录组结构感知的预训练比单纯扩大规模更关键，为低成本的临床表达预测提供了新途径。
llm.limitations_zh: 任务为临床结局预测而非细胞层面的扰动建模，与虚拟细胞的直接关联有限。

title: Disentangling Marginal Capacity from Geometry in Optimal-Transport Label Transfer
abstract: Optimal transport (OT) is widely used to align distributions and transfer labels between unpaired source and target data, but source-target composition shifts can cause rare classes to be systematically under-predicted even with high transport confidence. We identify a source of this failure in the transport marginal: under the standard uniform weighting of source points, each class has transport capacity proportional to its source frequency, which can be insufficient to meet its target demand even when separated well in the embedding space. We show that displaced mass is preferentially absorbed by high-capacity classes rather than geometrically similar classes, producing confident errors that are difficult to detect from the transport plan. Downstream read-outs, entropic smoothing, and marginal relaxation provide limited recovery, whereas matching the transport marginal to the target composition substantially improves label transfer. On single-cell data, the oracle composition-matched marginal raises macro-F1 from 0.322 to 0.623, and the best deployable estimator closes 69% of the oracle gap. Correcting the marginal also separates a coverage-dependent component of error from residual error associated with class separability, showing that transport capacity and representation geometry are distinct sources of transfer error.

llm.novelty_zh: 指出最优传输标签迁移中边缘分布的运输容量错配是稀有类误判的来源，并通过匹配目标组成加以纠正。
llm.summary_zh: 研究指出，在源-目标组成偏移下，最优传输标签迁移中稀有类因源样本频率决定的运输容量不足而被系统低估，错误质量会集中流向高容量类别。作者证明仅校正运输边缘就能显著改善结果：在单细胞数据上，oracle 组成匹配边缘将 macro-F1 从 0.322 提升至 0.623，最佳可部署估计器弥补了约 69% 的差距。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 区分了运输容量与表征几何两类独立的迁移误差来源，对单细胞注释中的分布偏移有指导意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: CloneOT: predicting clone-specific perturbation responses with lineage-supervised neural inverse optimal transport
abstract: Predicting single-cell perturbation responses requires mapping between two unpaired populations of cells measured before and after the perturbation. Optimal transport (OT) provides a principled framework for constructing such mappings by minimizing the transport cost, and neural OT methods (\textit{e.g.}, CellOT) have been employed for this prediction task. However, these methods rely on a fixed transport cost, typically the squared Euclidean distance. This cost may connect cells with the wrong responses. Lineage tracing provides the information needed to learn the cost, as heritable barcodes link the cells of the same clone before and after the perturbation. Here, we propose \CloneOT, a neural inverse OT method that learns both the transport cost and the transport map from partially lineage-traced single-cell datasets. \CloneOT\ represents the cost as a neural network. It learns the cost by minimizing the extra cost that the lineage adds to the optimal transport, so that the cheapest transport keeps the cells of each clone together. Our experiments demonstrate that \CloneOT\ recovers the correct transport on 2D datasets, while the squared Euclidean cost fails. Moreover, \CloneOT\ outperforms five baselines on 14 lineage-tracing perturbation scenarios of cancer cells, for both seen and unseen clones. Furthermore, we show that \CloneOT\ reveals the clone-specific transcriptional programs of drug-tolerant persister cells and forecasts the fate of each clone from its cells before treatment. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/CloneOT.

llm.novelty_zh: 利用谱系条形码学习神经最优输运的代价函数，而不是使用固定的欧氏距离。
llm.summary_zh: CloneOT 用可学习的神经网络代价函数替代固定欧氏距离，通过最小化谱系带来的额外代价，使最便宜的输运保持每个克隆的细胞聚在一起，并同时学习输运映射。在14个癌细胞谱系追踪扰动场景中，它优于五个基线，并能揭示耐药持留细胞的克隆特异转录程序，依据治疗前细胞预测各克隆的命运。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 把谱系信息纳入扰动预测的输运代价中，可以更好地区分不同克隆的响应。
llm.limitations_zh: 需要部分谱系追踪数据，适用范围受限于带有条形码标记的数据集。

title: Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening
abstract: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. More importantly, predictions with larger deviations from the additive baseline tend to have larger errors. Conventional output-based and embedding-based confidence signals are inconsistent across datasets and models, whereas AD remains informative across all evaluated compositional settings. We further study how this signal can guide decisions in an agentic perturbation-screening workflow. The code is available at https://github.com/zygao930/OOD.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出加性偏差（additive disagreement）诊断未见基因组合的外推不确定性，替代传统的输出与嵌入置信度。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作针对未测量基因对组合的扰动预测，比较模型预测与两个单基因效应之和的差异，定义了加性偏差（AD）。在八种方法与三个Perturb-seq数据集上，专用神经预测器并未稳定优于加性基线，且偏差越大误差越大。作者还展示了AD在智能体扰动筛选流程中的决策作用。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该诊断信号能识别扰动预测模型何时在组合外推上不可靠，有助于实验设计前的可信度判断。
llm.limitations_zh: 研究集中于三个Perturb-seq数据集的组合设置，摘要未报告在其他实验类型上的泛化结果。

title: Resolving Structural Uncertainty in Stochastic Dynamical Systems via Ensemble-Based Bayesian Inference
abstract: Recovering the interaction structure of complex stochastic dynamical systems from sparse time-series observations is an inherently ill-posed inverse problem. The posterior over network configurations is high-dimensional, highly degenerate, and shaped by the non-equilibrium nature of the available data. To address this, we propose a fully Bayesian, ensemble-based inference framework. Our approach grounds a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) likelihood formulation---acting mathematically as an Onsager-Machlup quasi-potential for non-equilibrium paths---within a non-parametric Minimum Description Length (MDL) structural prior. This framework rigorously penalizes model complexity and avoids kinetic overfitting by forcing continuous parameters into a finite vocabulary of discrete categories. The joint posterior is optimized using a block-coordinate scheme combining sub-quadratic Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) topological sampling with deterministic Nelder-Mead parameter optimization. Using highly non-linear macroscopic population dynamics as a benchmark, we demonstrate that inference requires non-stationary transient data to resolve causal information. Furthermore, we prove that propagating structural uncertainty via ensemble-based posterior analysis produces significantly more robust and reliable predictions for downstream perturbation outcomes than traditional single-point (MAP) estimates. The framework is highly generalizable, capturing fundamental topological constraints even under severe generative model mismatches, offering a robust tool for uncertainty-aware inference in complex stochastic systems.

llm.novelty_zh: 将SDE似然与MDL结构先验结合，用集成贝叶斯后验刻画稀疏时间序列中网络结构的不确定性。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作针对随机动力系统，从稀疏时间序列中推断相互作用结构，把SDE似然与非参数MDL先验结合，并用MCMC拓扑采样与Nelder-Mead参数优化进行块坐标推断。在非线性种群动力学基准上，作者认为集成后验对扰动结果的预测比MAP估计更稳健。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法为从有限时间序列推断复杂系统结构并量化不确定性提供了通用工具，对扰动预测的不确定性分析有一定借鉴意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 基准为宏观种群动力学，摘要未给出在生物细胞数据上的验证。

title: Synergy-Aware Residual Flow Matching for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: Predicting single-cell responses to genetic and chemical perturbations is important for understanding regulatory mechanisms and prioritizing therapeutic interventions. Existing methods have made progress by modeling perturbation-conditioned expression shifts with neural networks, graph priors, foundation-model representations, or distributional generative models. However, combinatorial perturbation prediction remains challenging because much of the response can be explained by additive single-perturbation effects, while the biologically informative signal often lies in a smaller non-additive residual induced by perturbation interactions. Directly generating the full post-perturbation expression profile may therefore allocate substantial capacity to the dominant additive component and underemphasize synergy-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SynGeneFlow}, a synergy-aware flow matching framework that anchors the source distribution at an additive prior and learns a residual flow toward the true perturbed state. SynGeneFlow further incorporates perturbation-conditioned gene interaction modeling, where a static gene-gene mask provides biological structure and a perturbation-dependent deformation bias dynamically modulates gene-gene coupling. To preserve population-level response structure, we align both endpoint distributions and biological residual distributions with MMD-based regularization. We evaluate SynGeneFlow on genetic and drug perturbation benchmarks under observed-single, held-out, and cross-modality settings. The results demonstrate that residualizing flow matching around additive perturbation effects provides a biologically grounded and robust framework for single-cell perturbation response prediction.

llm.novelty_zh: 以加性先验为源分布、学习残差流来捕捉组合扰动中的协同信号，并用静态基因互作掩码与扰动依赖偏置调制基因耦合。
llm.summary_zh: SynGeneFlow 以加性单扰动效应作为源分布锚点，用残差流匹配学习朝真实扰动态的输运，以捕捉较小但关键的协同残差。模型结合静态基因-基因掩码与扰动依赖的变形偏置，并用 MMD 对齐终点分布和残差分布，在遗传与药物扰动基准及跨模态设置下进行了评估。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 强调了组合扰动中协同部分的建模，对多扰动效应预测有针对性意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体数值结果或基线对比，协同信号的贡献无法从摘要判断。

title: Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models
abstract: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

llm.novelty_zh: 以直接拟合冻结历史速度场的方式替代轨迹采样式生成回放，在连续时间下实现稳定性与可塑性的混合传输。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作面向连续时间生成模型的终身学习，提出trajectory replay，让更新后的速度场同时拟合冻结历史速度场沿轨迹的输出与新任务速度场，从而避免生成合成样本。理论分析表明最优解是两任务速度场按密度平均，并结合mean velocity distillation减少每次更新所需的网络评估次数。在类别增量图像生成及两个生物学案例中，该方法将生成式扰动模型扩展到新情境并保持处理效应预测能力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为扰动生成模型在新细胞情境或实验批次中持续更新、同时保留历史知识提供了思路。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

llm.novelty_zh: 以相对细胞-细胞关系与保留方向的几何归纳偏置编码局部组织环境，使表征具有平移不变性，并可零样本外推到更大组织。
llm.summary_zh: Tessera 是空间转录组表征学习框架，结合空间信息引导的基因选择与几何归纳偏置，用相对的细胞间关系编码每个细胞的局部组织环境，既平移不变又保留方向信息。在未见组织与不同技术上，其表征质量优于现有空间基础模型，并可零样本泛化到比训练情境大至 16 倍的组织环境。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为跨组织、跨平台的空间细胞表征提供了更强的泛化能力。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Shared clones make random cell halves look reproducible in pooled screens
abstract: Single-cell perturbation screens are used to train and evaluate models of perturbation effects, and model scores are judged against the reproducibility of the measured effects. Reproducibility is usually judged by splitting each perturbation's cells into two random halves, assumed to be independent replicates. In pooled screens such as Perturb-seq, the cells carrying a guide RNA descend from a limited number of transduced cells, so two random halves contain the same clones: pseudoreplication whose unit is not marked in the data. Using null perturbations (no expected effect) as controls, we compared random halves with independent replicates from separate transductions, and tested directly with halves that differ only in their clones. In a genome-scale screen of primary T cells, null perturbations agreed between random halves almost always and between independent replicates only half the time, the rate expected from noise alone; more cells did not remove it. With halves that share no clone, split by the T-cell receptor constant region or by a clone barcode, the excess agreement largely disappeared. Under a simple model, consistent with a screen that recorded clones, its size equals the share of expression differences set by clones divided by the effective number of clones per perturbation; in cell lines an upper bound on it was small. In the T-cell screen, shared clones inflated benchmark ceilings and reliability labels, the more so in donors with fewer effective clones, and when a model's input and scoring answer come from one transduction, published models that predict effects in a new cell state scored well even on perturbations with no expected effect; for the model tested (STATE), the gain vanished with the same guide from another transduction as answer. Reproducibility is better judged across separate transductions than between random halves.

llm.novelty_zh: 指出随机二分细胞会因共享克隆而高估可重复性，并以跨转导（cross-transduction）的独立重复作为更合理的评测基准。
llm.summary_zh: 利用无预期效应的空扰动作为对照，发现在原代T细胞全基因组Perturb-seq中随机半细胞之间的一致性远高于独立转导重复。通过按TCR恒定区或克隆条形码切分后，多余的一致性基本消失，并表明该偏差会抬高模型基准上限与可靠性标签。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 直接影响扰动模型基准的构建方式，提示许多已发表的模型分数可能因伪重复而被高估。
llm.limitations_zh: 主要验证集中在一个T细胞筛选和一个模型（STATE），细胞系中仅给出上界估计。

title: Escaping cells dilute CRISPR screen responses unequally across cell types
abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens run in many cell types are used to compare how cell types respond to perturbation, to train models that transfer effects between them and to score such models. These uses assume that cells carrying a guide RNA had their target knocked down. Yet cells grow for days before sequencing: when an essential gene is knocked down, knocked-down cells are depleted or stop dividing while cells that escaped knockdown keep growing, and the measured response, an average over all cells carrying the guide, is diluted. We define the escape fraction of a perturbation as the share of its measured cells whose target was not effectively knocked down, and estimate it from each cell's counts of the targeted gene with a two-group mixture that recovers known fractions in simulated mixtures. In most cell types the escape fraction rises with how essential the gene is, it is higher in a later screen of the same cells, and it reaches about half of the measured cells in human embryonic stem cells (hESCs). It predicts how much each response is diluted: the response size falls to (1 - e)^2 of that of the knocked-down cells. Because the escape fraction differs between cell types, it changes all three uses: hESCs respond like K562 cells unless knockdown depletes them, the coefficient a simple transfer model learns is lowered by the dilution of the cell type it predicts, and a benchmark scored on all cells rewards predictions shrunk towards no change, partly because that ground truth is itself diluted. Where cells stop dividing instead, the response also contains expression differences between cell-cycle stages. Response sizes should be compared on knocked-down cells or corrected for the escape fraction.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出扰动的逃逸分数（escape fraction）及两组混合模型估计方法，量化未被有效敲低细胞对扰动响应的稀释。
llm.summary_zh: 研究发现单细胞 CRISPR 筛选中有相当比例的带 gRNA 细胞并未真正被敲低，且逃逸比例随基因必需性升高。响应大小会按 (1−e)² 被稀释，这影响细胞类型间迁移、迁移模型系数与基准评分。作者建议在敲低细胞上比较响应，或对逃逸分数进行校正。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作揭示了基准真值本身被稀释的问题，直接影响扰动模型的评估与跨细胞类型迁移结论。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未展开两组混合模型在真实数据上的估计误差范围。

title: Do Language Models Know What Compelling Scientific Evidence Looks Like?
abstract: Expert scientists excel at weighing empirical findings from multiple sources that vary in both statistical reliability and epistemic relevance. To what extent are language models, which are increasingly driving autonomous discovery systems, capable of such evidence deliberation? We introduce EDB-Bio, a scientific reasoning benchmark curated from real-world data in three biological domains: drug-perturbation transcriptomics, CRISPR screens, and human genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Each of EDB-Bio's 96k episodes presents a sequence of experimental results from published studies and asks the model to predict the probability that a target hypothesis is true. Out-of-the-box, open-weight and frontier models alike demonstrate systematic underconfidence and attain Brier scores comparable to a trivial base-rate forecaster. Post-training against strictly proper scoring rules significantly improves both calibration and discrimination. This calibration pays off downstream: in a sequential experiment selection task, our Ibis0 model is 2.5 times more efficient than the best frontier model. Throughout, quantifying evidence weights as Bayes factors reveals how models update their beliefs over time, whether they agree with expert biologists on relevance, and where they exhibit inconsistencies and biases. Our work extends calibration training and uncertainty analysis to a realistic scientific forecasting setting with applications to human cancer biology. We release all code, data, and trained models.
affiliations: MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory

llm.novelty_zh: 以科学证据序列评测语言模型的校准能力，并用严格适当评分规则进行后训练。
llm.summary_zh: 研究构建了 EDB-Bio 基准，包含约 9.6 万个由已发表的药物扰动转录组、CRISPR 筛选与 GWAS 结果组成的推理情景。开箱即用的模型普遍欠自信，经严格适当评分规则后训练的 Ibis0 在序列实验选择任务中的效率为最佳前沿模型的 2.5 倍。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作揭示了语言模型在科学证据加权上的校准缺陷，并表明校准训练可改善实验选择，对 AI 辅助科研有直接意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 基准主要聚焦癌症生物学相关数据，摘要未提及其对虚拟细胞建模任务的直接迁移性。

title: scAnyOmics: Foundation-Model Distillation for Any-to-Any Completion of Multi-omics Virtual Cells
abstract: Recent advances in single-cell technologies have enabled the profiling of multiple molecular modalities, including transcriptomics, proteomics, and chromatin accessibility, providing a more comprehensive understanding of cellular states. However, integrating heterogeneous modalities and predicting missing molecular information remain challenging, particularly when paired measurements are limited. Here, we introduce scAnyOmics, a generative framework that distills knowledge from a frozen single-cell foundation model into a multimodal student model. scAnyOmics integrates scRNA-seq, protein-marker measurements, and scATAC-seq into a shared representation, enabling cross-modal prediction and reconstruction of missing modalities. We assembled 690,880 cells from six publicly available studies, covering both paired and partially paired multi-omics measurements, to systematically evaluate its predictive performance. We further evaluated scAnyOmics on held-out donor data, where it outperformed baseline methods across multiple evaluation metrics. Beyond cross-modal reconstruction, we explored its applications in cell-type annotation, perturbation-response prediction, and biological age estimation. Overall, scAnyOmics provides a unified framework for integrating incomplete single-cell multi-omics data and transferring pretrained biological knowledge, supporting the development of virtual cell models across diverse cellular contexts and experimental platforms.

llm.novelty_zh: 从冻结的单细胞基础模型蒸馏知识到多模态学生模型，实现模态间的缺失补全。
llm.summary_zh: scAnyOmics 将 scRNA-seq、蛋白标记和 scATAC-seq 整合到共享表征中，通过从冻结的单细胞基础模型蒸馏知识，支持跨模态预测与缺失模态重建。在六个公开研究、共690,880个细胞上评估，留出供体数据上优于基线，并探索了细胞类型注释、扰动响应预测和生物学年龄估计。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为不完整多组学数据的整合以及基础模型知识迁移提供了统一框架。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出扰动预测部分的定量结果，也未说明各任务的具体基线。

title: Genetic risk and inflammatory signaling converge on cell type-specific regulatory programs in type 1 diabetes
abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a complex autoimmune disease characterized by the destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β cells. Both genetic susceptibility and epigenetic dysregulation contribute to T1D risk. Recent studies have reported β-cell dysfunction before disease onset, suggesting that β-cell-intrinsic mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis. However, the mechanistic link between disease-associated variants and β-cell dysfunction remains poorly understood. We hypothesized that a subset of T1D-associated variants directly influences cell type-specific candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) by disrupting transcription factor (TF) binding and altering gene expression. To define cell type-specific cCREs in human islets, we integrated publicly available epigenomic datasets, including bulk histone modification profiles and single-cell multiomic data from human pancreatic islets. We combined these data with T1D genome-wide association study (GWAS) variants to identify disease-associated SNPs located within enhancer regions. Using multiomic datasets from PANC-DB, we characterized cell type-specific chromatin accessibility in nondiabetic and T1D islets and identified regulatory regions that may control gene expression in β cells and other islet cell types. We then applied ChromBPNet, a deep learning model that predicts base-pair-resolution chromatin accessibility from scATAC-seq data, to evaluate how specific variants may alter local regulatory activity. In parallel, we used TF footprinting to nominate TFs likely to bind these variant-containing regions. These analyses identified several T1D-associated SNPs predicted to alter chromatin accessibility at candidate TF binding sites, suggesting mechanisms by which noncoding variants may contribute to β-cell dysfunction and T1D susceptibility. Our findings link T1D-associated variants to cell type-specific enhancer activity and regulatory pathways and provide candidates for future mechanistic studies.

llm.novelty_zh: 将T1D风险变异与胰岛细胞类型特异的顺式调控元件及ChromBPNet预测结合，定位可能改变染色质可及性的变异。
llm.summary_zh: 作者整合胰岛表观基因组和单细胞多组学数据，将T1D的GWAS变异定位到增强子区域，并利用ChromBPNet与TF足迹分析评估这些变异对染色质可及性的影响。研究提示若干SNP可能通过改变转录因子结合影响β细胞功能。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为非编码变异在T1D中的机制研究提供了候选位点与调控通路线索。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要中的SNP结论基于计算预测，摘要未提及实验验证。

title: Octave: Scale-Resolved Evaluation of Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
abstract: Spatial gene expression prediction from histology is typically evaluated by the mean per-gene Pearson correlation (PCC). PCC does not distinguish spatial scales: coarse tissue organisation alone can earn most of the score. A domain oracle makes this precise: given an image-derived partition of the tissue, the predictor that assigns each domain its measured mean expression is the best that any predictor constant on that partition can do. On a widely used benchmark with a ∼100 µ m pitch, a learnable version that estimates each domain's mean from training data reaches 82% of the PCC of a trained model, and a partition of the spot coordinates alone, given measured means, reaches 123%. At that pitch the score rewards coarse spatial structure whatever its source. We introduce O ctave , a scale-resolved evaluation that filters prediction and measurement into spatial bands with widths in micrometres and scores their agreement in each band. On 16 µ m Xenium data, differences that look modest under PCC grow at finer scales: at ∼20 µ m the oracle's shortfall relative to the trained model is 2.4 times its PCC shortfall at the median and exceeds it in all 13 specimens. Across 57 image encoders the finest band reorders 261 of the 1596 encoder pairs relative to PCC. The benchmark's own finest band is 50 µ m wide, coarser than the scale at which these differences appear, so no score on that pitch can directly validate finer structure. O ctave reports how well a model predicts spatial expression at each spatial scale.
affiliations: The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston

llm.novelty_zh: 提出按空间尺度分频带评估基因表达预测的 Octave 指标，并用 domain oracle 揭示平均 PCC 对粗尺度结构的过度奖励。
llm.summary_zh: 研究指出，从组织学预测空间基因表达时常用的平均 PCC 会被粗粒度组织结构主导，甚至一个只使用测得域均值的 oracle 也能获得很高分数。作者提出 Octave，将预测与测量滤波到不同宽度（微米）的空间频带中分别比较一致性。在 16 µm Xenium 数据上，细尺度的差异更明显，并且在 57 个图像编码器、1596 个编码器对中，其最细频带重排了 261 对的排序。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 让空间表达预测的评估能区分不同尺度上的预测能力，减少粗尺度结构带来的虚高分数。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: Slide-level batch structure limits histology-guided supervision of transcriptomic foundation models
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics pairs spatially resolved gene expression with tissue morphology in the same tissue section. Transcriptomic foundation models encode such expression profiles into general-purpose representations, but these representations can retain slide- and cohort-specific variation that obscures biological signal. Here, we test whether matched H&E histology can improve these representations as a training-time supervisory signal that is discarded at inference. Across three transcriptomic foundation models, histology-guided supervision provides no consistent aggregate improvement in cross-donor annotation transfer, despite substantially stronger transfer from histology alone. We find that gene-expression embeddings from spot-based spatial transcriptomics are low-dimensional and strongly structured by slide identity, limiting the shared gene–morphology signal available for cross-modal transfer. Guidance benefits some morphologically distinctive classes but reduces held-out gene predictivity broadly across the transcriptome. These results suggest that cross-modal supervision can reorganize information already encoded in a frozen representation but cannot recover information the representation does not retain, highlighting the importance of diagnosing slide-specific structure before applying such supervision. Code availability: https://github.com/ratschlab/vision-guided-transcriptomics-fm-2026

llm.novelty_zh: 检验训练期H&E监督对转录组基础模型表征的改进效果，并诊断切片特异结构对跨模态迁移的限制。
llm.summary_zh: 研究在三个转录组基础模型上检验配对H&E组织学作为训练期监督信号（推理时丢弃）的效果，发现其在跨供体注释迁移上没有一致的总体提升。作者认为，空间转录组点状数据的嵌入低维且受切片身份强烈塑造，限制了可用于跨模态迁移的基因与形态共享信号。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提醒在空间组学基础模型中应先诊断切片批次结构，再施加跨模态监督。
llm.limitations_zh: 组织学监督虽对部分形态上可区分的类别有益，但会广泛降低留出基因的预测能力

title: The recoverable resolution of cellular perturbation-response prediction
abstract: Virtual cell models aim to predict how cells respond to perturbations, yet accurate prediction of post-perturbation gene expression can conceal failures to recover context-specific responses. Here we identify context geometry compression (CGC), in which models preserve cellular identity and shared perturbation effects while collapsing differences in how the same perturbation acts across contexts. Across biological systems, reproducible context-specific responses remained difficult to recover; in a large drug-response matrix, this persisted even with nearly complete perturbation coverage. The same drug-response predictions achieved higher normalized recovery in predefined pathway summaries than in gene-level response profiles, while coarse response programs were more predictable in human lymphoblastoid cell lines. Compact baseline transcriptomic representations retained most full-RNA predictive performance for patient-specific ex vivo drug responses. Together, these findings establish recoverable biological resolution, rather than measurement dimensionality, as a criterion for evaluating virtual cell predictions and matching model outputs to the biological detail supported by evidence.

llm.novelty_zh: 提出情境几何压缩（CGC）现象，并以可恢复的生物学分辨率而非测量维度作为虚拟细胞预测的评估标准。
llm.summary_zh: 研究发现，虚拟细胞模型在保持细胞身份和共享扰动效应的同时，会压缩同一扰动在不同情境下的差异（情境几何压缩，CGC）。在大型药物响应矩阵中，即使扰动覆盖接近完整，情境特异性响应仍难以恢复；通路汇总层面的响应比基因层面更易预测。作者据此提出以可恢复的生物学分辨率作为评估标准。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为判断高精度预测是否掩盖了情境特异性失败提供了新的评价视角。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明药物矩阵的规模及所用模型的具体范围。

title: Additive-input encoding fails operator-level target-held-out prediction on current Perturb-seq screens
abstract: Pooled Perturb-seq screens are often interpreted through a linear steady-state model in which each targeted gene supplies an additive perturbation input. Although this formulation identifies an operator on the observed response subspace in closed form, identifiability alone does not establish that inferred operators generalize to new perturbation targets. We evaluated fixed program-space additive inputs in three Perturb-seq screens — Replogle K562 essential, Replogle RPE1 essential, and Jost 2020 — using target-grouped nested cross-validation and matched signal-to-noise linear-truth controls. For inverse operator prediction, real held-out error remained at the predict-zero baseline (0.96, 1.00, and 1.00), whereas matched linear controls achieved 0.18, 0.53, and 0.72. This discrepancy persisted across random K562 target panels, an overdetermined Jost dimension sweep, direction-only fits, ridge and truncated-SVD estimators, and five linear ground-truth ensembles. Forward target-held-out prediction was more nuanced: fixed, footprint, and learned linear encodings modestly beat a predict-training-mean baseline in K562 but not in RPE1 or Jost, and the K562 gains recovered only about 7% of the gap to the matched linear control. On the tested screens, fitted fixed program-space operators should not be interpreted as validated target-generalizing regulatory operators. We release anchor-op, a reproducible toolkit for target-grouped evaluation, identifiability checks, and matched-geometry positive controls for perturbation-response models.

llm.novelty_zh: 以目标分组嵌套交叉验证和匹配几何的线性对照，检验加性扰动算子对新靶点的泛化能力。
llm.summary_zh: 研究在三个 Perturb-seq 筛选中检验加性输入的线性稳态模型。对留出靶点的逆向算子预测误差停留在零预测基线水平，而匹配的线性对照可达到明显更低的误差；前向预测仅在 K562 中略优于训练均值基线。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 警示拟合得到的扰动算子不应直接视为已验证的可泛化调控算子，并提供了 anchor-op 评估工具。
llm.limitations_zh: 结论限于三个筛选与线性框架，摘要未探讨非线性模型在相同设置下的表现。

title: VINTER: a generative vision–language model for annotating and interrogating spatial tissues
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics links gene expression to tissue structure, yet current models learn embeddings whose meaning is assigned afterwards or read histology without measured expression. Tissue decisions are therefore rarely made from morphology, genes and neighbourhood together, or examined through them. Here we introduce VINTER, a generative vision–language model aligned on 1.45 million histology–caption pairs that reads histology, measured gene expression and spatial neighbourhood as one sequence. It returns the probability of every tissue class, and because genes enter as text, its molecular evidence can be edited with the image held fixed. Reading all three sources together, VINTER annotated tissue more accurately than spatial-domain methods and a spatial foundation model, and transferred across cohorts without target labels. Editing only the neighbourhood resolved the follicular B-cell and plasma-cell programmes behind its reading of tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) maturation in lung and kidney cancer. Its class probabilities exposed what single labels conceal in triple-negative breast cancer: immune heterogeneity within stroma and cancer hidden beneath benign labels. Without retraining, the same model transferred to Visium HD and single-cell Xenium data and resolved follicular architecture within colorectal cancer TLS. VINTER thus turns spatial annotation into an interrogable reading of tissue across platforms and resolutions.
affiliations: Institute of Medical Science, The University of Tokyo

llm.novelty_zh: 把组织学图像、基因表达文本与空间邻域统一到生成式视觉语言模型中，用于空间组织注释和可编辑的分子推理。
llm.summary_zh: VINTER 在 145 万组织学-描述文本对上训练，把组织图像、以文本输入的基因表达与空间邻域一起读取，并输出各组织类别的概率。它的注释精度优于空间域识别方法和一个空间基础模型，并可在无目标标签时跨队列迁移。仅编辑邻域信息即可解释肺癌与肾癌中三级淋巴结构的成熟程序。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 把空间注释从单一标签变成可交互的组织解读，便于在多平台上检验分子机制假设。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: How many cells resolve a perturbation direction? A closed-form, control-aware cell quota for single-cell perturbation screens
abstract: Single-cell perturbation screens increasingly infer mechanism from the direction of a treatment’s displacement in a shared transcriptomic embedding, yet no sample-size rule states how many cells that direction needs. We derive a closed-form, anisotropic cell quota for the treated cells required to hold the angular error of an estimated perturbation direction at a chosen tolerance. Because noise aligned with the effect changes only its length, the quota depends on the noise perpendicular to the effect, on the effect magnitude and on the control-pool size, and it diverges below a magnitude floor set by the control alone. The deterministic core is machine-checked in Lean 4. Across four public atlases (six screens) reprocessed through one embedding, the per-cell noise variance is near 1.0 on chemical and genome-wide genetic platforms. On Tahoe-100M, referenced to its plate-shared DMSO vehicle of about 3,100 cells, 55% of 56,827 conditions are control-pool-limited and only 11% are over-sampled at a 5.7-degree tolerance. Genome-wide CRISPRi knockdowns are instead detection- and depth-limited. A downsample-and-measure test on every atlas recovers the parameter-free angular-error slope. The calculator turns a pilot covariance, an effect magnitude and a control design into a per-condition cell budget and flags conditions that no treated depth can resolve.

llm.novelty_zh: 给出扰动方向角误差的闭式、各向异性细胞配额公式，并以 Lean 4 机器验证核心推导。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作推导了单细胞扰动筛选中估计扰动方向所需处理细胞数的闭式配额，并在四个公开图谱（六个筛选）上进行验证。在 Tahoe-100M 上多数条件受对照池大小限制，并提供按条件计算细胞预算的工具。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为单细胞扰动实验设计提供了可计算的样本量规则，有助于减少细胞数不足或浪费。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未讨论所设假设在其他噪声结构下的稳健性，而全基因组 CRISPRi 的结论受检测与深度限制。

title: DECONVersation: Single-Cell Foundation Model-Derived Embeddings for Robust Cell Type Deconvolution of Bulk RNA-seq
abstract: Motivation Bulk RNA-seq deconvolution uses single-cell references to estimate cell type proportions in bulk tissue. Existing methods face challenges with batch effects, subject-level variation, and marker gene selection. We propose a new approach leveraging general-purpose single-cell foundation models. Results DECONVersation combines pretrained or fine-tuned single-cell foundation model embeddings with non-negative least squares for deconvolution. The embeddings eliminate the need for explicit marker selection, and reduce batch effects. Compared against MuSiC, DWLS, and BayesPrism, DECONVersation with Geneformer or Cell2Sentence-2B achieved competitive performance across six bulk datasets with ground truth, with performance improvements after reference-specific fine-tuning. Availability and Implementation DECONVersation is available through the Python Package Index. The source code is available at https://github.com/nygenome/DECONVersation, and the datasets and Apptainer/Singularity images are archived on https://zenodo.org/records/22949405. Contact rfu@nygenome.org Supplementary information Supplementary data are available online.

llm.novelty_zh: 用单细胞基础模型嵌入替代标记基因选择，结合非负最小二乘进行bulk RNA-seq细胞比例反卷积。
llm.summary_zh: DECONVersation 用预训练或微调的单细胞基础模型嵌入结合非负最小二乘估计bulk组织中的细胞类型比例，无需显式选择标记基因，并可减弱批次效应。在六个带真值的bulk数据集上，它与Geneformer或Cell2Sentence-2B的组合和MuSiC、DWLS、BayesPrism相比具有竞争力，参考数据微调后进一步提升。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了scFM嵌入在具体生物信息任务中的实用价值，且已发布Python包与代码，便于直接复用。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation: a framework for the faithful assessment of genetic perturbation target identification
abstract: Identifying which gene drives a desired cell-state transition is a foundational inverse problem in target discovery and cell-state engineering, yet far less developed than forward prediction. We show that prevailing benchmarks inflate performance through two artefacts: training leakage, where test-perturbation cells are seen during fitting, and evaluation leakage, where the perturbed gene’s own expression change exposes the answer. Here, we introduce Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation (CEE), a framework that separates train and test perturbation targets, removes target-gene self-effects from expression profiles and scores candidates in downstream response space. With CEE, we find that simple structure-based methods consistently outperform complex deep learning models across 16 single-cell perturbation datasets, revealing that the recoverable signal is governed by low-rank and additive structure in perturbation responses rather than by model complexity. Our work disentangles evaluation artefacts from genuine predictive capacity and offers a design principle for developing perturbation target identification methods.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
State Key Laboratory of Stem Cell and Reproductive Biology
Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science
Beijing Institute for Stem Cell and Regenerative Medicine

llm.novelty_zh: 提出Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation，分离训练与测试靶点并去除靶基因自身效应，避免评测泄露。
llm.summary_zh: 提出CEE评测框架，用于评估基因扰动的靶点识别任务，修正训练泄露与评测泄露两类人为抬高性能的问题。作者在16个单细胞扰动数据集上发现，简单的基于结构的方法持续优于复杂深度模型，说明可恢复信号主要来自低秩与可加结构。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了逆向靶点识别基准中的评测偏差，并为公平比较该类方法提供了设计原则。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体的方法名与数值差距，结论是否推广到其他扰动类型尚需验证。

title: Concurrent de novo inference of cell types and gene regulatory networks with NetMap
abstract: Existing methods for GRN inference based on single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data typically require prior cell type calling and then infer GRNs at cell type resolution. This risks propagation of errors from cell annotation to GRN inference. Moreover, it makes existing methods blind to regulatory programs that are shared between different cell types, as well as to subtle differences in regulatory activity between cells of the same type. To address these limitations, we present NetMap, a pipeline that jointly infers cell-level GRNs and clusters cells based on shared regulatory programs, combining state-of-the-art single-cell autoencoders and explainable artificial intelligence methods. NetMap outperforms existing methods on synthetic data with a known ground-truth GRN and is able to reliably detect biologically plausible regulons on real data. Moreover, requiring only a small set of user-provided marker genes, NetMap can be used for GRN structure-informed probabilistic cell type assignment. We demonstrate the utility of this approach using PBMC data, where we achieve near perfect clustering and cell type recovery performance compared with manually created cell type labels. Finally, we applied NetMap to a data set with naïve, activated and exhausted T-cells, and were able to verify that NetMap retrieves relevant T-cell state signatures from the data, with two approaches. NetMap can be installed as a python package from https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap and is compatible with the scverse system. Scripts to reproduce our results can be found at https://github.com/bionetslab/netmap-evaluation.

llm.novelty_zh: 用单细胞自编码器与可解释 AI 联合推断细胞级 GRN 与细胞聚类，避免先验细胞类型注释带来的误差传播。
llm.summary_zh: NetMap 同时推断细胞水平的基因调控网络，并依据共享调控程序对细胞聚类，在带已知真值的合成数据上进行了评估。论文报告其在 PBMC 数据上实现了接近完美的细胞类型恢复，并能识别初始、活化与耗竭 T 细胞的状态特征。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将细胞类型识别与 GRN 推断耦合，可减少误差传播，并以兼容 scverse 的 Python 包形式便于复用。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及该方法在更多真实数据集上的稳健性。

title: Transcriptional perturbation effects remain structured beyond the leading global trend
abstract: Prior work has described a global transcriptional response to gene perturbation, with many perturbations moving cells along a common direction. We find that perturbations contribute differently to this leading global trend and that substantial organization remains beyond it, including transferable perturbation-specific effects across datasets and a common hierarchy of responsive genes across perturbations. These patterns make simple strategies surprisingly competitive even in predicting effects beyond the leading global component.

llm.novelty_zh: 揭示全局主趋势之外仍有可跨数据集迁移的扰动特异效应，以及跨扰动共享的响应基因层级。
llm.summary_zh: 作者发现不同扰动对全局转录主趋势的贡献存在差异，主趋势之外仍有可跨数据集迁移的扰动特异信号和跨扰动共享的响应基因层级。研究指出，在预测主趋势之外的效应时，简单策略仍具有竞争力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提示扰动预测基准应同时考察主趋势之外的结构，避免被全局相关性误导。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Beyond the Final Layer: Evaluating Single-Cell Foundation Model Representations for Molecular Prediction
abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are commonly benchmarked using final-layer embeddings, although useful depth may depend on the task. We evaluate Geneformer, scBERT, scGPT, and scFoundation as frozen feature extractors for cell-type and perturbation-response prediction using layer-wise probes, leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) selection, readout controls, representation diagnostics, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and retrieval/collapse analyses. Intermediate layers significantly improve cell-type accuracy for scGPT and scBERT in several settings, while Geneformer and scFoundation generally show performance comparable to their final layers. For perturbation prediction, LODO identifies layer 1 as an earliest-on-par candidate across all four models, without establishing universal superiority. Paired scGPT CLS and mean-pooling analyses show that readout affects preferred depth. CKA and representation metrics reveal model- and task-dependent geometric changes, while retrieval and collapse checks support the robustness of perturbation findings. We recommend reporting extraction depth, readout, selection protocol, and task-specific diagnostics. A validated non-final layer may also reduce computation, although efficiency was not directly benchmarked.

llm.novelty_zh: 系统比较 scFM 各层表征在细胞类型与扰动预测中的表现，并提出提取深度、读出方式与选择协议的报告建议。
llm.summary_zh: 研究以逐层探针评估 Geneformer、scBERT、scGPT 和 scFoundation 作为冻结特征提取器的表现，采用留一数据集（LODO）选层、读出控制、CKA 以及检索与塌缩分析。中间层在部分设置中显著提升了 scGPT 与 scBERT 的细胞类型准确率；在扰动预测中，第1层可作为四个模型共同的早期候选，但并非普遍最优。作者建议报告提取深度、读出方式和选择协议。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 提醒评估基础模型表征时不应只看最后一层，对方法比较的公平性有直接价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未直接评估计算效率，扰动预测的优势也未被确立为普遍结论。

title: A split-control criterion for few-shot adaptation in single-cell perturbation prediction
abstract: Few-shot adaptation can help or harm single-cell perturbation prediction, but conventional evaluation shares a control estimate between calibration responses and held-out targets. We show how methods carry control error into their predictions and derive its contribution to score inflation. Nested control-depth experiments support inverse-depth scaling of inner-product inflation; correlation inflation also depends on the control noise-to-signal ratio. Independent-control scoring changed the rank of 40 of 52 configuration–dataset entries. We introduce SafeDelta, a split-control criterion that uses calibration data to decide whether to adapt. Across six datasets, mean gated gain was non-negative under the original two-control evaluation. On a deep plate, fixed predictions and decisions retained positive mean gains under three additional independent control references. The same reproducibility principle identified a fibrosis programme that localises to scar in human liver. These results inform adaptation decisions and control-depth planning.
affiliations: Macau University of Science and Technology

llm.novelty_zh: 提出 SafeDelta 分割对照准则，利用校准数据决定是否进行少样本适应，并揭示共享对照导致的分数膨胀。
llm.summary_zh: 作者分析共享对照误差如何使预测与评估分数膨胀，并提出 SafeDelta 利用校准数据判断是否进行适应。在六个数据集上，原始双对照评估中平均门控增益为非负；采用三个额外独立对照参照时，固定预测与决策仍保持正增益。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为少样本适应的评估与决策提供了可靠的评估原则，能减少乐观偏差。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及该准则在更大规模数据集或其他对照设计下的稳定性。

title: VirtualSkin integrates skin-cell identity with intervention-response prediction
abstract: Human skin atlases resolve a diverse set of cellular states, yet connecting these states to their responses to intervention remains difficult across independently sampled tissues. Here we present VirtualSkin, a cell–language model that aligns skin transcriptomes with biological descriptions and supports intervention-conditioned response prediction. We evaluated the model across independent atlas, disease, anatomical and perturbation cohorts, with donors, studies and perturbations withheld according to the experimental design. VirtualSkin improved inflammatory-skin annotation by 0.056 macro-F1 points and cell–text retrieval by 0.12 Recall@10 points relative to the strongest corresponding comparators. The representation retained cell identity during study integration and transferred across ageing, systemic sclerosis, lymphoma and anatomical sites. Across five intervention cohorts, response prediction improved by 0.03–0.09 response-score points, with agreement at the levels of gene-expression change, gene recovery and transcriptional programs. Paired tissue trajectories provided a complementary assessment in two donors per intervention. Component ablations and pairing controls localized the predictive contributions, while uncertainty estimates supported selective prediction under distribution shift. These results connect skin-cell recognition to intervention-response prediction within a common evaluation framework and define the conditions under which predictions can inform experimental prioritization.

llm.novelty_zh: 将皮肤转录组与生物学文本描述对齐，构建支持干预条件响应预测的细胞-语言模型。
llm.summary_zh: VirtualSkin通过细胞-语言对齐把皮肤细胞转录组与生物学描述相连，并支持干预条件下的响应预测。在留出的供体、研究与扰动队列上，它在炎症皮肤注释和细胞-文本检索上优于最强对照，五个干预队列的响应分数提高0.03至0.09，并给出不确定性估计。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将细胞身份识别与干预响应预测置于统一评估框架下，为实验优先级排序提供了可检验的依据。
llm.limitations_zh: 响应预测的提升幅度较小（0.03至0.09），配对组织轨迹仅在每种干预的两名供体中评估。

title: Single-Cell Behavioromics Enables Fate Prediction of Individual Hematopoietic Stem Cells
abstract: Summary Achieving near-single-cell precision in the prospective identification of long-term engrafting hematopoietic stem cells (LT-HSCs) remains challenging, likely because current static, point-in-time single-cell phenotyping technologies do not capture the dynamic nature of cell fate decisions. Here, we overcome this barrier by longitudinally tracking individual hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) in ex vivo niche cultures using live imaging, coupled with downstream immunophenotyping, single-cell transcriptomics, and transplant assays. Deep learning analysis of live imaging data achieved 98.5% average precision in predicting serially-engrafting LT-HSC (serial-LT-HSC) identity from each cell’s behaviorome (the totality of observed behaviors), outperforming currently available technologies. Serial-LT-HSCs exhibited lower motility among HSPC populations, which was associated with reduced Activin signaling activity and elevated expression of cell adhesion genes. Correspondingly, antagonizing Activin signaling by Inhibin-A treatment in ex vivo niche cultures suppressed HSPC motility while increasing the frequency of post-expansion serial-LT-HSCs, revealing a novel role for Activin signaling in HSPC behavior and fate determination. Collectively, this study establishes a broadly applicable framework that connects behavioromic analysis and single-cell transcriptomics to enable near-single-cell precision in predicting stem cell fate and uncover molecular mechanisms governing behavior-fate relationships.

llm.novelty_zh: 利用活细胞成像得到的行为组特征预测单个造血干细胞的命运，并发现Activin信号参与其行为与命运调控。
llm.summary_zh: 作者在离体龛培养中对造血干/祖细胞进行活细胞成像、免疫表型分析、单细胞转录组和移植实验，用深度学习从行为特征预测长期植入型造血干细胞，平均精度为98.5%。研究还显示Inhibin-A抑制Activin信号可降低细胞运动并提高长期植入型干细胞的比例。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了行为动力学可作为细胞命运预测的特征，对造血干细胞的前瞻性鉴定具有实验参考价值。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及该预测模型在其他组织或独立实验批次中的泛化能力。

title: Perturb-Seqr: Signature Search Engine Integrating Connectivity Mapping Resources
abstract: High-throughput transcriptomics can be used to develop Connectivity Mapping resources for identifying potential reversers and mimickers of disease signatures for drug and target discovery. Recently, several new Connectivity Mapping datasets have emerged, but no efforts were made so far to evaluate and integrate them. Motivated by this opportunity, we have developed Perturb-Seqr, a comprehensive Connectivity Mapping search engine that integrates nine small molecule transcriptomics Connectivity Maps and seven single gene perturbation followed by expression Connectivity Maps. Specifically, Perturb-Seqr contains processed data from LINCS (L1000), Tahoe-100M, Novartis Institute for Biomedical Research (DRUG-seq), the original CMap (cDNA microarrays), Ginkgo Bioworks (DRUG-seq), SciPlex (scRNA-seq), DeepCover MoA (PISA proteomics), Perturb Atlas (RNA-seq), Replogle et al. (Perturb-seq), CREEDS (cDNA microarrays), CM4AI (Perturb-seq), and RummaGEO (RNA-seq). To serve these Connectivity Maps in one unifying search engine, we converted the expression signatures from these resources into 450,271 gene sets of up- and down-regulated genes measuring the effects of 9,856 unique drug and 17,643 unique gene perturbations, targeting 917 cell lines and cell types. We demonstrate how Perturb-Seqr, and the gene sets it serves, can be used to identify targets for drugs and drugs for targets, uncover new pathways, and identify potential side effects for preclinical compounds. Overall, Perturb-Seqr is a comprehensive up-to-date Connectivity Mapping search engine and database, enabling the discovery of new drugs and targets. Perturb-Seqr is accessible from: https://perturbseqr.maayanlab.cloud/.
affiliations: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

llm.novelty_zh: 统一整合多个小分子与单基因扰动连接图谱，形成可检索的450,271组上下调基因集。
llm.summary_zh: Perturb-Seqr是一个连接图谱检索引擎，整合了9个小分子转录组连接图谱与7个单基因扰动后表达的连接图谱，并将其转化为450,271个上下调基因集，覆盖9,856种药物扰动、17,643种基因扰动以及917种细胞系或细胞类型。作者展示了其在靶点与药物互找、通路发现及临床前化合物副作用识别中的用途。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为药物与靶点发现以及扰动数据复用提供统一的检索基础设施。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Deep-learning-driven tumor microenvironment profiling improves immunotherapy response prediction
abstract: Immunotherapy has transformed the management of many cancers, such as clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), yet durable clinical benefit is achieved in only a subset of patients. Immunotherapy outcomes are governed by the multicellular tumor microenvironment (TME), through the structured and directional interplay of regulatory programs and ligand-receptor communications. Yet most existing methods for immunotherapy response prediction rely on independent signatures or cell types and fail to model the structured and directional signaling network within the TME. To address this gap, we introduce EcoNet, a computational framework that first models ecosystems consisting of co-occurring cell states, then constructs intercellular and intracellular signaling networks based on the ecosystems, and applies a graph attention network to derive embeddings from the signaling network for immunotherapy response prediction. Pretrained on 2,532 pan-cancer immunotherapy samples across multiple cohorts, EcoNet outperformed existing prediction methods by 7.5-19.9% and marker-based signatures by 4.4-21.2% in AUC, and its high-attention genes were enriched among those required for T-cell-mediated tumor killing in an independent CRISPR screen; applied to ccRCC with disease-specific fine-tuning, it stratified an independent ccRCC cohort by clinical outcome ( P =0.024). Biologically, high-attention genes capture an interferon-responsive program that enhances antigen presentation and immune infiltration. To validate these findings, we curated a ccRCC clinical cohort profiled with CosMx single-cell spatial transcriptomics (46 samples, ~450,000 cells) and found the response-associated TME configuration identified by EcoNet localized to immune-enriched niches, supporting the response stratification. These results establish EcoNet as a generalizable framework for TME-informed therapeutic response prediction, readily extensible to other cancer types and therapeutic contexts.

datasets_used: CosMx single-cell spatial transcriptomics ccRCC cohort
llm.novelty_zh: 将共现细胞状态构成的生态系统与细胞间及细胞内信号网络结合，用图注意力网络预测免疫治疗响应。
llm.summary_zh: EcoNet 基于共现细胞状态构建生态系统，建立细胞间与细胞内信号网络，并用图注意力网络学习嵌入以预测免疫治疗响应。在 2532 个泛癌免疫治疗样本上预训练后，其 AUC 优于既有方法，并在 ccRCC 队列与空间转录组队列中提供了分层与定位证据。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 将肿瘤微环境信号网络用于治疗响应预测，为临床分层提供了可解释的生物学线索。
llm.limitations_zh: 应用集中于免疫治疗临床队列，与虚拟细胞或扰动建模关联较弱，摘要也未详细说明 ccRCC 验证队列的规模与统计功效。

title: DEPICT enables sample-centric therapeutic prioritization across evolving and spatially heterogeneous tumor states
abstract: Accurate treatment selection remains a major challenge in precision oncology because tumors with similar genomic alterations can respond differently to therapy. Most drug-response models evaluate individual drugs or drug-sample pairs, whereas clinical decision-making requires therapies to be prioritized within each tumor context. Here we present DEPICT (Drug Efficacy Prediction via Integrated ConText), a sample-centric deep learning framework that reframes drug-response prediction as the relative prioritization of therapies within an individual tumor context. DEPICT integrates transcriptomic and mutational features with prior alteration-therapy relationship and was trained on 231,880 cell line-drug pairs comprising 941 cancer cell lines and 289 compounds. Without retraining, DEPICT retained predictive performance in independently profiled cell lines, experimentally induced drug-resistant states and matched primary lung tumors and patient-derived organoids. Representations learned exclusively from bulk pharmacogenomic data further captured progressive drug-response states at single-cell resolution and outperformed existing single-cell drug-response inference methods. Applied to spatial transcriptomic data, DEPICT resolved clone-associated therapeutic heterogeneity within individual lung tumors, and predicted regional differences were recapitulated in matched multiregional organoid drug-response assays. These findings establish sample-centric therapeutic prioritization as a transferable strategy for modeling dynamic and spatially heterogeneous drug vulnerabilities across biological scales.

llm.novelty_zh: 把药物响应预测重构为单个肿瘤背景内的疗法相对排序，并融合先验的改变-疗法关系。
llm.summary_zh: DEPICT是一个样本中心的深度学习框架，结合转录组、突变特征与先验改变-疗法关系，在231,880个细胞系-药物对上训练。无需重训即可用于独立细胞系、原代肺肿瘤和类器官，并能把批量药理基因组学学到的表征推广到单细胞分辨率，揭示肺肿瘤内的治疗异质性。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为临床治疗排序以及肿瘤内空间异质性药物敏感性建模提供了可迁移的策略。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及

title: Generative inverse design steers human hematopoietic cell fate in vitro
abstract: Summary Inverse design has advanced the discovery of molecules and materials. Yet it remains largely unexplored for steering cell fate, where inputs are continuous, combinatorial culture conditions and outputs are distributions of cell states. Human hematopoiesis, in which combinations and doses of growth factors steer stem cells toward each blood lineage, is a demanding test case. While forward models can evaluate discrete conditions, the vast combinatorial space renders searching for a specific, target-producing design an intractable inverse problem. Here, we introduce LabCompass, an inverse-modeling framework that optimizes experimental designs toward candidates expected to produce specified target cell states, using a flow-matching generative model guided by cellular phenotypes predicted by a forward surrogate. We applied LabCompass to primary human CD34+ in vitro cultures, where continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters govern hematopoietic cell fate. In a lab-in-the-loop setting, we experimentally validated model-driven designs and used these measurements to update the model across four successive loops. LabCompass recovered established lineage-inducing designs, improved predictions with new data, and enriched target populations across lineages. Incorporating new parameters expanded the design space and enriched rare populations beyond initial reach. Across loops, we generated a 78-million-cell spectral flow cytometry dataset and identified distinct culture conditions converging on the same target cell states. Our results establish generative inverse modeling as a compelling paradigm for navigating high-dimensional, continuous experimental spaces, and demonstrate that virtual cell models should be judged not only by how accurately they predict cellular responses, but also by how effectively they guide experiments toward desired biological outcomes.

datasets_used: CD34+ in vitro culture spectral flow cytometry
new_dataset_names: LabCompass hematopoiesis spectral flow cytometry dataset
llm.novelty_zh: 将流匹配生成模型与前向代理预测结合，在连续培养条件空间中逆向设计目标细胞状态，并通过实验闭环验证。
llm.summary_zh: 该工作提出LabCompass，利用流匹配生成模型并由前向代理模型引导，优化人CD34+造血细胞的培养条件以产生目标细胞状态。作者进行了四轮实验室闭环验证，并生成了一个7800万细胞的谱系流式细胞术数据集。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 它展示了生成式逆向设计在高维连续实验空间中指导实验的可行性，对虚拟细胞模型的实际应用有重要意义。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及。

title: From Closed-Set Annotation to In-Context Discovery: Biologically Grounded LLMs for Cellular Profiling
abstract: Tumour heterogeneity reflects both cellular identity (lineage) and state (active transcriptional programs), yet computational methods generally analyse these axes separately. We introduce CellScribe, a generative framework that conditions a pretrained language model on frozen single-cell foundation model embeddings through AdaLN adapters, enabling one shared model to generate an ontology-grounded cell type or a quantified meta-program profile. Supervised multitask fine-tuning produces fine-grained typing across hundreds of cell types and outperforms generative and retrieval baselines on meta-program identification under study-holdout evaluation. We further train the model with reinforcement learning, scoring its generations against cell ontology distance and meta-program agreement, so that they align with biological knowledge rather than token agreement. To identify new cell types not present in the supervised training data, we post-train the model to read several labelled example cells in a single context, each conditioning its own text span, and infer the type of a query cell through in-context learning. CellScribe thus unifies cell identity and state in one generative interface, grounds both in biological structure, and identifies cell types outside the supervised vocabulary.

llm.novelty_zh: 用 AdaLN 适配器将预训练语言模型条件化于冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入，统一生成本体约束的细胞类型与元程序谱。
llm.summary_zh: CellScribe 在冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入上条件化语言模型，既能生成本体约束的细胞类型，也能生成量化的元程序谱。模型经监督多任务微调，并以基于本体距离与元程序一致性的强化学习训练，再通过上下文学习识别监督训练集之外的细胞类型。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将细胞身份与细胞状态统一到一个生成式接口中，为基础模型驱动的细胞注释与解释提供了新途径。
llm.limitations_zh: 摘要未提及与其他 LLM 基线在训练数据规模与推理成本上的比较。

title: GRASS-MIL: graph-based representation and discovery of phenotype-associated spatial structures with multiple instance learning
abstract: Tissue function is shaped by both cellular composition and the spatial organization of cells. Spatial single-cell technologies capture this organization across tissue sections, enabling tissue architecture to be linked to disease phenotypes, prognosis and treatment response. However, many current graph-based predictive models depend on assay-specific molecular features, limiting joint analysis of cohorts profiled with incompatible panels, and either aggregate local predictions uniformly or rely on post hoc importance scores that do not directly decompose the basis of a sample-level prediction. Here we introduce GRASS-MIL, a graph multiple-instance learning framework that learns the relative relevance and class-specific evidence of individual cellular neighborhoods, predicts phenotypes across platforms, and decomposes each sample-level prediction exactly into signed contribution from each local neighborhood. These contributions are terms of the prediction itself rather than a post hoc approximation and sum exactly to the predicted logit. In simulations, GRASS-MIL distinguished phenotypes with identical global cell-type composition but different spatial organization, whereas composition-based classifiers performed no better than chance. A single model trained jointly on CosMx spatial molecular imaging, Xenium and MERFISH datasets, harmonized only through a shared cell-type vocabulary, predicted treatment status in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.74 and associated this prediction with two stromal architectures: an immune-rich niche admixed with malignant cells and a desmoplastic niche characterized by malignant-cell exclusion. Applied to spatial proteomics data from non-small-cell lung cancer, GRASS-MIL identified distinct niches associated with relapse (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, 0.57), including myeloid-rich niches in relapsing tumors and adaptive immune niches in non-relapsing tumors. In a separate lung adenocarcinoma cohort, a similar lymphoid-myeloid polarity was observed when predicting 3-year mortality (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, 0.62), with a B-cell and CD4+ T-cell niche associated with favorable outcome and a neutrophil and macrophage niche associated with adverse outcome. GRASS-MIL thus combines cross-platform phenotype prediction with an exact, signed decomposition of each prediction into the cellular neighborhoods on which it depends, providing a direct route from sample-level prediction to testable hypotheses linking tissue architecture with patient phenotypes.

llm.novelty_zh: 用图多示例学习对细胞邻域做有符号的精确分解，使样本级预测可直接追溯到各局部邻域的贡献。
llm.summary_zh: GRASS-MIL是一个图多示例学习框架，以共享细胞类型词表对齐CosMx、Xenium和MERFISH等空间平台的数据，跨平台预测表型，并将每个样本的预测精确分解为各细胞邻域的符号贡献。在卵巢癌、非小细胞肺癌和肺腺癌队列中，它识别出与治疗状态、复发和预后相关的免疫与基质微环境。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为组织空间结构与患者表型之间的关联提供了可追溯的解释路径，并支持跨平台空间组学队列的联合分析。
llm.limitations_zh: 部分队列的预测性能较低（AUROC为0.57至0.62），摘要未讨论其他局限。

title: STARgrid - an open end-to-end pipeline for Visium HD
abstract: Grid-based spatial transcriptomics quantifies expression by counting reads, assigning them to genes and, from their barcodes, to capture locations on a grid, which is registered to a microscope image. For Visium HD, only the vendor's Space Ranger performs all these steps, and its licences prohibit redistributing it or software derived from it. We present STARgrid, an open-source, end-to-end, agent-ready pipeline from Visium HD FASTQ files and images to count matrices registered to the tissue. Its counts agree closely with Space Ranger's (gene-total correlations at least 0.9989); it runs 2.0-3.4 times faster and counts 1.9-7.6% more molecules. Unlike Space Ranger, STARgrid always assigns each read to the closest-matching barcode, which gives 0.8-1.1% of matched reads a different location, mostly where adjacent-row barcodes overlap, and places another 2.9-4.6%. This choice and settling ties for each molecule from all its reads are the largest source of added molecules. Around nuclei, counts follow a reproducible pattern: more molecules in a ring just around each nucleus, usually with a dip under it. STARgrid registers the image by matching the nuclei to the whole pattern with the correlation ratio, even where the dip is weak or absent. On lung tissue imaged by Xenium on the same section, this places the nuclei where Xenium does or one capture location away.
